notes: Work your kit does for you ships when you approve it. A run that passed its tests and got your go-ahead was still being turned back with "tester did not record a sha", because the sha reached one part of the record and not the other. It reaches both now.

Turning the continuity audit on no longer trips the deep dream on kits that do not carry the pinned probe set. Those probes were only ever about one kit's memories, so they stay off elsewhere, and a kit without the file treats it as an empty pool rather than an error.
Your conversations show your name above your own words. The timeline had a hardcoded name in that spot; it now uses the operator name your kit already knows.

The health page tells the difference between something wrong now and something that happened days ago: a process that flapped and has been quiet since reads green with the history kept, and a row waiting on you is amber and opens itself.
